back: A written promise to repay a specific amount (face value) at a fixed future date, usually with interest.
Key parties: [[kw:maker]] (borrower) and [[kw:payee]] (lender).
Can be interest‑bearing or non‑interest‑bearing.
The amount borrowed (principal) stated on the note.
In an interest‑bearing note, the face value is the basis for calculating interest.
In a simple discount note, the face value equals the maturity value.
A note that states an annual interest rate.
Maturity value = Face value + Interest.
Interest is computed as $$I = \text{Face Value} \times R \times T$$ using a 360‑day year.
A note without a stated interest rate.
Maturity value = Face value (no extra interest).
Often used for short‑term or special loans; still may involve interest via discounting.
$$I = \text{Face Value} \times R \times T$$
T is in years; use days/360 for time.
Maturity value = Face value + I.

Compute interest and maturity value for a $10,000, 6% note for 90 days.

back: A loan where the interest (bank discount) is deducted in advance from the face value.
Borrower receives [[kw:proceeds]] = Face value − Bank discount.
At maturity, borrower repays the full face value.
The interest deducted in advance on a simple discount note.
$$\text{Bank Discount} = \text{Face Value} \times \text{Discount Rate} \times T$$
Also called the discount amount.
The amount the borrower actually receives after the bank discount is subtracted.
$$\text{Proceeds} = \text{Face Value} - \text{Bank Discount}$$
Always less than the face value.
cards.front: What are [[kw:proceeds]] in a simple discount note?
A $5,000, 8% simple discount note for 90 days. Find bank discount and proceeds.
back: Borrower receives $4,900 but repays $5,000.

cards.front: How does the [[kw:effective rate]] of a simple discount note compare to its stated rate?
back: The effective rate is always higher than the stated discount rate.
$$\text{Effective Rate} = \frac{\text{Bank Discount}}{\text{Proceeds} \times T}$$
Because the borrower pays interest on the full face value but receives only proceeds.
